title: Rational exponents分数指数

quiz.q: Evaluate 32−3/5 without a calculator.不用计算器，求 32−3/5。
opts: 81​
−8
8
−596​
quiz.hint: Root (5th), then power (3), then reciprocal.先开 5 次方，再 3 次方，最后取倒数。
quiz.why: Correct: 532​=2, 23=8, reciprocal 81​.正确：532​=2，23=8，取倒数得 81​。
whys: Correct: 532​=2, 23=8, reciprocal 81​.正确：532​=2，23=8，取倒数得 81​。
Read the negative exponent as a negative answer; it means reciprocal.把负指数当成结果为负；负指数表示取倒数。
Ignored the minus sign in the exponent — forgot the reciprocal.忽略了指数上的负号，忘了取倒数。
Multiplied the base by the exponent; an exponent is not a multiplier.把底数和指数相乘了；指数不是乘数。

quiz.q: Simplify (x−1/6x1/2⋅x1/3​)2, x>0.化简 (x−1/6x1/2⋅x1/3​)2，x>0。
opts: x4/3
x2/3
x2
x
quiz.hint: Work only on the exponents: add, subtract a negative, then double.只算指数：相加、减负数、再乘 2。
quiz.why: Correct: 21​+31​+61​=1, then (x1)2=x2.正确：21​+31​+61​=1，再 (x1)2=x2。
whys: Subtracting −61​ was done as subtracting 61​: 21​+31​−61​=32​. Minus a negative is plus.减去 −61​ 被当成减去 61​：21​+31​−61​=32​。减负数等于加。
Multiplied 21​⋅31​ when multiplying powers; same base multiply means ADD exponents.同底数相乘时把指数相乘成 21​⋅31​；应该相加。
Correct: 21​+31​+61​=1, then (x1)2=x2.正确：21​+31​+61​=1，再 (x1)2=x2。
Got the inside right (x1) but forgot the outside power 2.括号里算对了（x1），但漏了外面的平方。

quiz.q: Earthquake energy: the energy E released (in some units) is related to magnitude M by E=101.5M. For a magnitude-4 quake the energy is E4​=106. Show that a magnitude-6 quake releases 1000 times as much, and write the ratio of energies between magnitudes M+2 and M as a power of 10. Then find the magnitude whose energy is 104.5.地震能量：释放的能量 E（某种单位）与震级 M 的关系为 E=101.5M。4 级地震的能量是 E4​=106。证明 6 级地震释放的能量是 4 级的 1000 倍，并把震级 M+2 与 M 的能量比写成 10 的幂。再求能量为 104.5 的震级。
quiz.hint: Divide 101.5(M+2) by 101.5M with the quotient law. For the last part set 1.5M=4.5.用除法法则计算 101.5(M+2) 除以 101.5M。最后一问令 1.5M=4.5。
quiz.ans: Ratio =103=1000 for any M; the magnitude with E=104.5 is M=3.对任意 M，比值都是 103=1000；能量为 104.5 的震级是 M=3。
quiz.why: Magnitude 6: E6​=109, and 109/106=103=1000.6 级：E6​=109，109/106=103=1000。
